Viscous_Slime_Mold_Coating.description: This entity is enveloped in a layer of viscous, acid-secreting slime mold that grants it enhanced stealth and agility, while also conferring resistance to fire and the ability to traverse difficult terrain with ease.

Hardened_Spore_Shell_Carapace.description: This fungal exoskeleton is a chitinous shell hardened by the very spores it houses, offering a robust natural armor that repels even the sharpest of blades, though its cumbersome nature slightly hinders agility.

Fibrous_Mycelium_Mat_Hide.description: Woven from the resilient threads of ancient mycelium, this fungal integument provides a protective shield that not only fortifies the body with enhanced strength and constitution but also whispers the secrets of nature's rejuvenation, granting the bearer a semblance of the forest's self-healing powers.

Toxic_Amanita_Cap_Skin.description: This eerie, fungal integument pulsates with vibrant hues of crimson and gold, its surface slick with a toxic mucus that deters most predators while enhancing the wearer's charisma and constitution.

Bioluminescent_Glow_Spores_Pelt.description: Woven from ethereal fungal filaments that pulse with otherworldly light, the Bioluminescent Glow Spores Pelt grants its wearer a deep connection to the arcane, enhancing their wisdom while the radiant glow slightly hinders their ability to remain hidden in the shadows.

Petrified_Wood_Fungus_Armor.description: Enveloped in a chitin exoskeleton interwoven with petrified wood and fungal spores, this armor provides a rugged defense that rivals stone, though it burdens the wearer with a slight reduction in agility, granting them resilience against both physical impacts and the forceful knockback of powerful attacks.

Velvety_Mossy_Fungal_Down.description: This entity is covered in a thick layer of velvety mossy fungal down, granting it an almost plant-like appearance and enhancing its ability to blend seamlessly into its surroundings, while also lending a subtle boost to its agility and stealth capabilities.

Oozing_Necrotic_Rot_Skin.description: The Oozing Necrotic Rot Skin is a loathsome, fungal exoskeleton that pulses with sickly green and black hues, constantly weeping a noxious, toxic slime that corrodes flesh and metal alike, its presence a harbinger of decay and despair, repelling all who witness it.

Cordyceps_Chitin_Plating.description: The Cordyceps_Chitin_Plating is a parasitic fungal armor that invades the host's body, weaving a tough, chitinous exoskeleton that not only enhances their natural defenses but also bolsters their physical strength, granting them the ability to withstand and deflect blows with a newfound resilience.

Translucent_Ghost_Fungus_Membrane.description: This ghostly, translucent membrane, woven from spectral fungal threads, grants the wearer unparalleled stealth and evasion, allowing them to slip through shadows unseen and blend into the ethereal realm with ease.
